status: Policy specification. Numeric thresholds marked PROPOSED have not been set by the owner; nothing is evaluated against them yet.

origination_order.rule: Originated first. Own fair spread is published before any total or moneyline is priced.
Originated second, after the side is recorded.
Originated last. Moneyline is derived from the same own distribution used for the side and total, not priced independently.

line_columns.fair_line: Own model output. Blank until a model is fitted on verified inputs and its as-of cutoff is recorded.
line_columns.market_line: Latest snapshot from the price store for the same market and side. Blank if no verified snapshot exists.
line_columns.difference: fair_line minus market_line, in points for spread and total, in implied-probability points for moneyline. Computed only when both inputs are present; otherwise blank.

price_store_rules: Every originated market needs an opening and a closing record. A missing opening or closing value is shown blank and flagged, never filled from another snapshot.
Each row records the book, the market page URL, the observation time in UTC (blank when not captured) and a verification status.
A single observation is recorded as an observation. It is not an opening or closing line.
results_feed_rules: Only final scores read from an official NFL page or Game Book count as verified results.
Every row links the official game-center page and the schedule page it was read from.
Results are never used as features for a forecast made for the same game (as-of rule G02).
leaderboard_rules: Two separate tracks. SIGNAL: probability quality against the no-vig market (log loss, Brier score, closing-line value, calibration). STAKING: bankroll path (ROI, drawdown, bet sizing).
Signal rank orders strategies on signal metrics only. Staking metrics are displayed beside the signal rank and cannot change it.
Eligibility for ranking requires every signal-track gate (G01 to G09) to pass. A favourable staking result cannot offset a failed signal gate.
Reward eligibility (G10) requires an eligible signal track, no open demotion trigger and a completed forward paper window (G11).
No strategy is ranked, rewarded or treated as live while any gate is not evaluated.

demotion_gate.applies_to: Any strategy with status LIVE. No strategy has LIVE status today.
demotion_gate.effect: Demote to PAPER at the next evaluation. Re-entry needs a new registered version (G03) and a fresh forward window.
demotion_gate.evaluation_cadence: After each completed NFL week, using only verified results (G02) and archived executable quotes (G07).
demotion_gate.non_offset_rule: Any trigger D1 to D5 demotes the strategy. A favourable staking result does not cancel a trigger, and no trigger can be overridden by ROI.
demotion_gate.override_rule: No override. Any exception is logged in COORDINATION.md with its trigger ID and source links before it takes effect.

triggers.name: Provenance or as-of breach
triggers.rule: Any G01 or G02 failure within a live period. Immediate demotion.

triggers.name: Signal quality breach
triggers.rule: Lower bound of the 95% bootstrap interval for (strategy log loss minus no-vig market log loss) is above 0 over the trailing window of non-push forecasts.

triggers.name: Calibration breach
triggers.rule: Any reliability bin with at least n_bin forecasts whose observed frequency falls outside the pre-registered tolerance.
triggers.threshold: n_bin = 30 and tolerance = pre-registered in the registration record (PROPOSED values)

triggers.name: Closing-line breach
triggers.rule: Mean closing-line value below 0 with a 95% interval entirely below 0 over at least N_min priced bets.

triggers.name: Dependence breach (combinations)
triggers.rule: A measured pairwise dependence outside its pre-registered band with n at least n_corr_min, or a joint model that fails G06.

triggers.name: Staking breach (separate track)
triggers.rule: Maximum drawdown above the pre-registered cap, or any stake outside the pre-registered sizing rule. Demotes the strategy to paper even if the signal track passes.
triggers.threshold: Cap to be pre-registered by owner

correlation_publication_rule: n (number of paired observations) is always published, even when it is 0.
A coefficient r is published only when every paired observation comes from an official source with a link, n is at least n_min = 30 (PROPOSED), and a 95% interval is shown.
Below that, r and its interval are blank and the status states the reason. No coefficient is estimated from unofficial or assumed prices.
jurisdiction_rule: No wager, stake or cash reward is placed, recommended or funded by this project. Any step beyond paper research requires a written legal determination for the user's jurisdiction (see Q10 and F28).
